name: Jezebel
source:
Welcome to Rosegate, a thriving medieval metropolis where treachery lurks around every corner. In this city of power and peril, the strong survive, and the weak perish.

You are Duvessa Devereux— a noblewoman and pale-skinned beauty, driven by insatiable lust for power and existential ennui. Scheme, seduce, or destroy your way to the top of Rosegate’s food chain as you navigate a web of ambition and betrayal.

Will you be a political mastermind, bending the kingdom to your will? Or will your arrogance lead to defeat? With RPG elements and branching choices, Jezebel lets you shape your Duvessa’s story. Play as the ultimate femme fatale— or as an overconfident fool. In Rosegate, noble life is a zero-sum game. The question is: will you rule, or will you submit?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4045080/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到玫瑰门——一座繁华昌盛却处处暗藏背叛的中世纪大都会。在这座权力与危机并存的城市里，唯有强者得以生存，弱者注定覆灭。

你将扮演杜薇莎·德弗罗——一位肤白貌美的贵族淑女，被无止境的权力欲与存在主义式的倦怠感驱使着前行。在这张由野心与背叛编织而成的罗网中纵横捭阖，用阴谋、诱惑或毁灭一路攀上玫瑰门食物链的顶端。

你将成为玩弄王国于股掌之间的政治幕后黑手，还是因狂妄自大而一败涂地？《耶洗别》融合了RPG要素与分支抉择，让你亲手谱写属于杜薇莎的传奇。你既可以化身极致的蛇蝎美人——也可以沦为自命不凡的蠢货。在玫瑰门，贵族生活是一场零和博弈。问题在于：你将君临天下，还是俯首称臣？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4045080/]Steam[/url]]
